newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania repairs port facility for oil tankers.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania repairs port facility for oil tankers.

text.p: Oil tankers can resume unloading their cargoes in Dar es Salaam after repairs to the port's offshore pumping facility which was out of operation for several months, port officials said on Sunday.
Dar es Salaam harbour is too shallow for large tankers, which have to unload their cargoes at a floating platform which had been out of action since developing leaks last August.
One tanker with a cargo of 85,000 tonnes of crude oil destined for landlocked Zambia had been waiting for two months to discharge its cargo.
Port officials said three waiting tankers were due to offload 250,000 tonnes of crude oil in the next few days.
